content: Zaqueo e-neggi Jesús-abingasad
Jericó-neggweburse Jesús modapgu, a-neggweburgi nadap gusad.
Agi dakleargu, machered-wargwen, Zaqueoʼye-nugad, mai-gusad. Zaqueo dakleargu, dulemar-Roma-dummadga-manigaedgi-arbamalad-e-dummadid, degine, dule-mani-ibedbalid.
A-dulede, Jesús-dakbigualid, wede Jesús doasunye. Ar Jesúsʼba-dulemar-nadapmalad bukidarsoggu, Zaqueo geg Jesús-dake-gualid, ar ade, Zaqueo dule-matukwagwad.
Zaqueo, Jesús-dakegala aimar-idu gwae abarmakde gusad, adi, sapi-Sicómoroʼgi nakwegar, ar ade, Jesús a-igargi nasoed.
Jesús a-sapi-gwichid mosgua, niba atakded, geb Zaqueoʼga sogded: —Zaqueo, gwae be dage, aidedage. Ar ade, emi-ibagi an be-neggi obunnogergebed.
Geb degi, Zaqueo gwae-gwae aidesad. Zaqueo weligwar na e-neggi Jesús-abingasad.
Dulemar daksamargu, Jesús, Zaqueo-negse dogsa, bela sunmakedbi-guarmalad, sogdemalad: “Jesús dule-isgudiid-negse dogsaye.”
Geb degi, Zaqueo gwisgusgu, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, emide, wegi an-ibmar an-na-nikadi, negabar dule-wileganaga an ukoed. Ar dule-gwensak-ibe an ibmar-atursasale, an ega ilabake bur-melu ukoed.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Emi-iba, we-neg-yaginmaladga isguedgi-abonoleged nonisun. Ar ade, we-dule, Abraham-e-wagwamogad.
Ar ade, ani Dule-Machi, dulemar-yoggusmalad-amiega nonikid, degi, dulemar-isguedgi-gudiid-abonogega nonikid.
Mani-igargi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús Jerusalén-neggwebur-walik gudisoggu, dulemar Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bato emarse oyolesokarye bimalanad. A-ular, Jesús dulemar-e-itosimaladga
burbar sunmakedgi sogded: “Dule-wargwen, nue-nug-nikadi, dikasuli yar-baidse reyga-nugsalegega nade gusad. A-dulede, gannar-danibaloye sogsa naded.
”A-dulede, nasokargu, ega-arbamalad-warambegwadse (10) gochad. Amarga mani-ichesur-uksagu, sogded: ‘An gannar dagedse, we-manigine be anga e-gaka onomalo.’
”Ar e-neggweburginmalad dule-reyga-guoed isdar-dakmarsoggu, naded-sorba dulemar-barmisad, dummaganga sogegar: ‘We-dule anmar-reyga-guega anmar abesurye.’
”Degi-inigwele, we-dulede reyga nugsalesad. Geb gannar e-yarse nonigua, e-maiganga-mani-uksadse gochad, adi, amarse egisega mani igi imaksamarye.
”Mai-gebesailad nonigu, reyga sognonikid: ‘Dummad, be-mani. An bega e-gaka ambe (10) an onosbalid.’
”Dummad ega sogdesun: ‘Nued, be, mai-nued. Ar ibmar-ichegwadgi be nued arbassoggu, neggwebur-gwaambedgi (10) dummadga be guo.’
”Mai-baid reyse nonimogu, ega sognonikid: ‘Dummad, be-mani. An bega e-gaka gwaatar onosbalid.’
”Dummad we-maiga amba deyob sogdebalid: ‘Neggwebur-gwaataledgi dummadga be gumogo.’
”Mai-baid nonibargu, reyga sognonikid: ‘Dummad, wegi an bega be-mani sedani, muswegi an bega nue-sabosad.
Ar an be-dobgusad, ar bede dule-yaisurdaed-duled. Ar be ibmar-urbissulidi be sudaed, ibmar-be-digsasulid be weedaed.’
”Geb degi, rey a-maiga sogdesun: ‘Be mai-isgana, na be-ibmar-sogsadba an bega sogsun. Ar be wisinad an dule-yaisurdaed-duled, an-ibmar-urbissulid an sudaed, an-ibmar-digsasulid an weedaed.
¿Ar ibiga degite, mani-urbileged-neggi be mani urbiapsuli? Adi, gannar an nonikogu, e-gaka-nosad an sunonikoenad.’
”Ar rey dulemar-bukmaladga sogdesun: ‘We-dule-mani-ukdanikid e-annik be sumar, dule-mani-ambe-onosadga (10) be ukmar.’
”Dulemar, rey-abin sogdemalad: ‘Dummad, ar we-dule mani-ambe (10) bato nikad.’
”E-dummad, amar-abin sogded: ‘Ar dulemar-bela-ibmar-nikmalad aga bur napi uklegoed. Ar dule-ibmar-suliddi, amba ar ibu wis nika, ei bur sulegoed.
” ’Deginbali, isdar-an-dakmalad, egi-dummadga-gubisur an-abesmaladi, anse be sedamar, an-asabin amar-e-dukar be egwanmalo.’ ”
Jesús, Jerusalénʼgi reyyob dogsad
Jesús weyob ibmar-sogsad-sorba, Jerusalénʼse e-sapingan-idumai gusad.
Jesús, Betfagé-neggweburse, degine, Betania-neggweburse modanigu, Olivos-yar-innikgusgu, Jesús e-sapingan-warbo barmisad.

Amarga sogsad: —Anmar-asabin neggwebur-bipigwad-siidse be namar. A-neggweburgi bemar dogdapmalar, moli-bipi-uayasuid, dule-egi-yoo-gwen-siged, be-idu atinnar-nai bemar dakdapoed. Be esikmalo, geb degi, be anse sedamalo.
Ar dule-wargwen bemarse egichialile: ‘¿Ibiga bemar moli-bipi-uayasuid esiknai?’ Ega bemar weyob sogmaloed: ‘Ar Dummad we-molibina soged.’
Jesús-e-sapingan-warbogwad nadmargu, igi-Jesús-ega-ibmar-sogsa deyob dakdapmalad.
Jesús-sapingan moli-bipi-uayasuid esiknanaigu, e-ibmala ega sokarmalad: —¿Ibiga moli-bipi-uayasuid bemar esiknai?
Abin sogdemalad: —Ar Dummad moli-bipi-uayasuidbina soged.
Jesús-sapingan moli-bipi-uayasuid Jesúsʼse senonimarsunnad. Geb degi, moli-bipi-birgi na e-mormar ogichamalad. Geb a-birgi, Jesús-onakwismalad.
Jesús, Jerusalénʼse nadapgu, e-iduar igargi dulemar mor ogitemalad.
Olivos-yar-aidemaid-walikgusgu, bela bukidar dulemar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, weligwar itodmalad, bela ibmar-dakledisulid-daksamaladba, binnasur Bab-Dummad-nug ogannodmalad,
sogdemalad:
Salmo 118:26
Abala Fariseoʼmar dulemar-bukidarad-abargi gudimarmogadi Jesúsʼga sokarmalad: —Odurdaked-saila, beba-nanaimaladse be urwe, mer deyob sogmarye.
Jesús, weyob amar-abin sogded: —An bega sogmar, ar wemar bogiledele, an-nug-odummomalaga akwamar oimakarmalaled.
Jesús Jerusalén-neggwebur-mosgu, Jerusalén-neggwebur-dakdegu, ega boded,
sogded: “¡Bitigi emi-ibagi be wisgusana gadin! Igi bogidiki be ambikusmalale. Ar emigindi, begi odukuar nagusad, adi, mer be magar itomalagar.
”Ar ibagan begi danikoed, be-isdarmalad be-ebilis napa gwisnonikoed, be-ebilis ambikunonikogu, geb degi, bela begi gwichigudamaloed.

Degi, geb napagi be-omukumaloed, be-dulamar-oburgwemaloed, degine, akwamar be-birgi-bubukwad bar be-birgi ambikuosurmalad. Bab-Dummad be-abonogega bese-atakleapid-iba aku be daksad-ular, deyob be guoed.”
Jesús, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-ukbukmalad-onosad
Jesús, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dogdapgu, dulemar-agi-ibmar-baknanaid, degi, ibmar-ukbukmalad sabsur onisad.
Jesús amarga sogded: —Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:
Isaías 56:7 ”Ar emigindi, bemardi atursamalad-negga imaksamalad.”

Jesús bane-bane Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi Bab-Dummad-igargi dulemar-odurdakdii gusad. Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagandi, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemardi, degi, dule-dummagan-neggweburgi-negsemamaiddi, Jesús-oburgwebigusmalad.
Ar amar geg Jesús-oakalogusmalad, ar ade, bela dulemar Jesús-nue-itobukwadamalad.
